steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Where am I...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Oh, you're finally awake.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: This is... home?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Demetri, why are you here?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Lavinia brought you back.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: According to the doctor, you passed out due to a combination of your injuries and fatigue.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Want an apple?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I knew you'd be hungry, so I already peeled it for you.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Where's Lavinia?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: She left after delivering you to the guards.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You should know by now that she's always been reluctant to set foot inside this mansion.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Her coming here for your sake is already a miracle in itself.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Carracci's death is actually a bit of an issue.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: And news of your injury is sure to get out.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: In the eyes of the other famiglie, the Bellones have, in a heartbeat, gone from the clear frontrunner to a total mess, both inside and out.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Someone could show up at any moment to try to take a bite out of us.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Did we keep any of the assailants alive long enough to get them to talk?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Unfortunately, no.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: And we couldn't find any leads on their bodies either.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I expected as much.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Any idea who could be behind this?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: The Saluzzos always kept their cards close to their chests, biding their time. For them, this is a prime opportunity.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: As for the Rossatis... They're probably victims too, since Wallach was with me when they attacked.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Still, Columbia's famiglie have never been a monolith.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: True, there's always the possibility of infighting among them.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Besides, there are even more possibilities.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Tch, they sure found themselves a nice opening.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Mind pouring me some water?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You bastard, barking out even more orders than usual when you're lying in bed.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Did... you really just pour me a cup of boiling water?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Is it my fault your order wasn't specific enough?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Alright fine, I know this is how you express your dissatisfaction with me. What is it this time?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: It's about the arrangement with Texas. I can't agree to it.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Lavinia is a righteous person who would never frame an innocent. She has her own ideas.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: That's not what I meant. She was supposed to be your sword.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: When the boss handed her over to you, that came with the assurance that she would not endanger the famiglia.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You should've forged her into a razor-sharp blade.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: But now, she's behind bars under Lavinia's watch.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You seriously can't tell that she's looking out for our famiglia's interests?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I'll admit, holding onto Texas after today would only make things more precarious for you.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: That her surname has appeared once more in Siracusa... draws far too much attention.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: In that sense, you have a point. From Lavinia's perspective, it's safer to have Texas in hand.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: But how is the rest of our famiglia supposed to see this?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: They'll start to think that Leontuzzo, the next don of Famiglia Bellone, has gotten addicted to playing house on top of the tablecloth. That you've gone soft.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: That not only do you not know how to swing a knife, you got it taken away from you.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: The Bellones already lost the advantage. No matter who comes looking for trouble, we need to fight back tooth and nail.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Leon, the development of Volsinii's new district is more than the humdrum business of il Ministero dei Lavori Pubblici. It should be under Bellone control.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: So that's what you really wanted to say to me.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I also have my own plans, Demetri.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Let's hear them, then.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Alright, fratello. You are my trusted advisor.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: When I got attacked, I already had the feeling that things weren't adding up. And after hearing about Carracci's death, that became even more clear.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You just asked me who I suspected could be behind this.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I don't actually think it's a Saluzzo or a Rossati.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Why's that?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: The hitmen knew me all too well.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: They knew exactly how to hit our Famiglia with speed and precision, while targeting me at the same time.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: So, what you're saying is—

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'm going to lock myself indoors for the next few days.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I need to recover from my wounds.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: If people think we're fumbling in disarray, then let them think that.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Until the true enemy shows their tail.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: So you let Lavinia take Texas on purpose.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: As for how she wants to play her hand, that's for her to decide.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: In the meantime, there will no doubt be a slew of attacks on our famiglia.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Pay close attention to whoever's scheming behind the scenes.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: So, was that a good enough answer for you?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Since you have a clear plan in mind, naturally I'll help you put it into action.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You are, after all, the boss here.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: That's what I want to hear.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Don't let me down, Demetri.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Hello, Wallach? It's me.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Leon, I heard you were injured. How are you doing?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: We need to talk about what happened earlier today.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'd imagine... you probably have something to ask me too. About that name.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: ...'Texas.'
Volsinii Prison

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: So, you were held up at the time.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Who was holding you up?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: An old acquaintance.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Awfully convenient for them to show up just then, don't you think?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You're pretty used to being in this kind of situation, aren't you?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Back in Lungmen, I'd sometimes let myself get interrogated like this.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Lungmen, huh...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Anyway, I'd have no reason to do anything like that.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That's what they all say.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: To be honest, though, I don't think you could've been the perpetrator, Cellinia. I can't imagine it would've done you any good.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Also, Leon contacted me beforehand and gave me a few reasons why I should trust you.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: So that's why you showed up at a venue where so many important figures were present. It was originally prepared as a stage for you by Famiglia Bellone.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: However, given the current circumstances, our best option is for me to keep you here.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You're protecting Leontuzzo.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm protecting you as well, Texas.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Also... this may divert the attention of the other famiglie. They will be speculating what Bellone's next move will be after getting hit like this.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: And those suspicions... might loosen some of the fetters around my ankles.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Are you really a judge?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Why would you ask that?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You seem to know a lot about how the famiglie operate.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I am, in fact, a judge.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But to be good at this job in Siracusa, you need to know how the mafiosi keep themselves alive, even better than they do.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Even if I'd rather not know.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You misunderstood me. It's not at all surprising that a law enforcement official would know a thing or two about the people you're enforcing it on.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But what I meant was that judges like you didn't exist back in the old Siracusa.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Don't get the wrong idea, Cellinia Texas.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I didn't bring you here because of the so-called checks and balances among the famiglie. Outsiders may interpret my stance as such, but I couldn't care less.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You just arrived in this city, and you still don't understand how important Ministro Carracci really was.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: He was an outstanding person. He could've made the new city under construction something far better.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: It wasn't just another project to expand his business, either. He wanted to make it possible for the citizens to enjoy a new way of life.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But he's dead now.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: And I will find his murderer and bring them to justice.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: They think they can dispose of the people who refuse to bend the knee one after another, as if they were puppets.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But I will make them realize that they are not tossing away a broken doll. They are murdering living, flesh-and-blood people.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: So, Carracci's death had nothing to do with you.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: And you didn't find out who the murderer was.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Pretty much.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: And the task I gave you, to investigate exactly why Bellone decided to bring back Texas? No leads there either?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You never miss a beat, my dear father.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: And despite having accomplished nothing at all, you didn't even bother showing up when I called to convene a meeting.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The traffic is pretty bad this time of year.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Lappland, when I kicked you out of the house seven years ago, you lost your right to call yourself a Saluzzo. Do you understand what that means?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Of course I do. It means you won't show any mercy when you decide to dispose of a disobedient tool like me.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You've always been so self-aware, yet never have the slightest inclination to act accordingly.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Do you really need me to personally deliver a little warning to the poor little Judgie?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Why would I feel a need to warn her?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Now that the princeling pup is hiding behind closed doors, everybody's gonna think the sharp-tongued little Judgie is a Bellone puppet.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And with your personality, you aren't inclined to believe that the Bellones are as weak as they present.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: So wouldn't it be common sense to use the judge's well-being to test the waters?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Seeing how you understand what to do, I want to see results.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Why naturally, I'd never disobey your orders. Assuming our interests align, that is.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: My dearest father.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Salvadore! What are we to do now?!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Am I to thank you for freeing me from the clutches of my own blood relative? Am I to thank you for spilling blood so that the Infected workers may have full stomachs?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: The man you killed was my father!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No, I do not need a list of his crimes. I should think I know them better than you. The scars on our bodies are proof of his cruelty. The deaths of those laborers were proof of his exploitation.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But still, despite it all!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Salvadore, I truly thank you from the bottom of my heart, for saving me and so many others.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But the stench of blood lingering about you grows stronger and stronger...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Let us be away from this place, Salvadore, just the two of us... Take me somewhere we will at last be able to find peace, alright?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: It might already be too late.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Salvadore, it might already have been too late the day you first set foot in Columbia, from when you first sharpened your blade...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You say this was all destined? That it couldn't have been avoided?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I can't help but think... If I were in Vivienne's place, would I be able to forgive Salvadore?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Even if what he did could be forgiven, the grudge would follow the both of them for the rest of their lives.
Exactly right, signorina.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh?
That the two of them were able to get together in the end is, of course, artistic license.
In fact, the real Salvadore did not elope with Vivienne.

Also, despite the fact that Vivienne's father was indeed as callous as he was wealthy, he took good care of his family - particularly Vivienne, whom he doted on like a diamond in the palm of his hand.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh...
Very rarely is someone pure evil, don't you think?
Therefore, even if the perpetrator was someone you loved dearly, even if you were aware of your father's despicable acts, something like what he did is not so easily forgiven.
Signorina Vivienne ultimately chose to leave him and move to a new city, where she met someone who truly loved her and thus began a new life.
But, until her last breath, she never forgot the man named Salvadore.
So in a sense, this story can be seen as vicariously helping her dream come true.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Did you... know Ms Vivienne well?
Hmm... I suppose you could say that.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: My name is Caterina. You're quite the lovely young actress.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Are you new here? I swing by frequently, but I've never seen your face before.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I am. My name is Sora, and I came from Lungmen.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Lungmen? How fascinating.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: I've heard of many actors who went to Lungmen to develop their careers, but rarely the other way around.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Sometimes, there's value in bucking the trend.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Too true.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So Miss Caterina, do you know what happened to the actual Ms Vivienne?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Vivienne, huh... She never forgot Salvadore.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Maybe that's why her son chose a similar path— he became a wise guy, and gradually rose to become the don of a certain famiglia.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: A famiglia that would eventually go on to clash against Salvadore himself.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Fortunately, Vivienne came forward and prevented the two rivals from becoming mortal enemies, and eventually they even became allies.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Wait, are you talking about the Rossati Family from the script?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: That's right. Have you already read through the entire thing?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yes... I also wanted to learn as much as I could about the Texas Family's history, for some personal reasons.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: So what did you think of the story?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I... There are a few bits I can't make sense of.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Oh? For example?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: For example, Salvadore's granddaughter...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sora, the stylist wants you to take a look at the design of your costume!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay, I'll be right there!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Sorry, but I have to go.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: I don't mind. We'll have another chance to talk.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sora—

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Take your time. We can always chat at our leisure some other day.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay, that's great!

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Salvadore's granddaughter.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You're wasting time at the theater again, boss.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: How many times do I have to tell you, Wallach? It's not a waste of time.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You pushed most of your work onto me just so you could go write a shitty play? Is that what the boss of a famiglia should be doing? And you even gave yourself a pseudonym?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Do you have a problem with that?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Of course not. You are none other than Giovanna Rossati, our beloved Donna.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I know you're dissatisfied with me.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Is there really anything in this city worth worrying over?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Before, no. But now, yes.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Carracci is dead.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: But Carracci was originally just a ordinary man, elevated by the famiglie to keep each other in check.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: All his death proves is that Bellone was not capable enough, nothing more.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: And someone greatly resembling Cellinia appeared at Leontuzzo's side.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Say that again?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Texas. Cellinia Texas.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Wallach, I don't recall you being the sort of man who liked to crack jokes.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: And you should also know that I hate people who joke about Texas more than anything else.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: So you can tell I'm not joking.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I have no idea how Bellone managed to find her, but she had those unmistakable eyes and hair.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Exactly like the one in your photo.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: So she didn't die...

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: And she's with Leontuzzo now.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: She would never have survived the liquidation if not for a certain famiglia protecting her.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: ...The logical conclusion is that Bellone saved her back then.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Looks like we're going to need to have a little chat.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Giovanna, this clearly is a trap—

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Wallach.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: ...My apologies, boss.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: It's not so much a 'trap' as an entire conspiracy.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Think bigger.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: If they really were the ones who saved her back then, what good does it do me to drop by and express my gratitude?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Make preparations. 'Business discussions' are over. I'm paying Volsinii a visit.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Understood. I'll make the arrangements.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Alas, it seems that the new script will have to go on the backburner for a while.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Boss, I'm sure you're aware that Carracci's death presents an excellent opportunity for us.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: But you still seem hung up on the Texas name.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: If this keeps up, the Rossatis won't have a future.
